title: Surface-Evaporation Accepted-Publication Provenance Remediation
purpose: Close FPM09-G01 only: prevent a physical surface-evaporation result from one transaction candidate being relabelled and accepted under another candidate's commit receipt.
scope: preservation of existing raw materialization entry point
out_of_scope: new globally unique solver-attempt identity contract

required_semantics.bound_result_creation: surface result and F-KT candidate provenance are assembled in one runtime operation after committed/candidate origin checks
required_semantics.publication_prepare: accepts only the opaque candidate-bound surface result, never a raw surface result plus caller-supplied candidate identity
required_semantics.publication_finalize: requires accepted commit receipt lineage, origin revision and interval to match prepared provenance
required_semantics.fail_closed_attack: result from candidate B plus accepted receipt A must not publish
required_semantics.mass: publication is attribution only and creates no second mass authority
